Frequently Asked Questions

When was Phil Cavarretta born?

Phil Cavarretta was born on July 19, 1916.

Where was Phil Cavarretta born?

Phil Cavarretta was born in Chicago, IL.

How tall was Phil Cavarretta?

Phil Cavarretta was 5-11 (180 cm) tall.

How much did Phil Cavarretta weigh when playing?

Phil Cavarretta weighed 175 lbs (79 kg) when playing.

How many seasons did Phil Cavarretta play?

Phil Cavarretta played 22 seasons.

Is Phil Cavarretta in the Hall of Fame?

Phil Cavarretta has not been elected into the Hall of Fame.

What position did Phil Cavarretta play?

Phil Cavarretta was a First Baseman and Outfielder.

How many hits did Phil Cavarretta have?

Phil Cavarretta had 1,977 hits over his career.

How many home runs did Phil Cavarretta have?

Phil Cavarretta had 95 home runs over his career.

What was Phil Cavarretta's average?

Phil Cavarretta had a .293 average over his career.

How many teams has Phil Cavarretta played for?

Phil Cavarretta played for 2 teams; the Chicago Cubs and Chicago White Sox.

How many World Series has Phil Cavarretta won?

Phil Cavarretta never won a World Series.

When did Phil Cavarretta retire?

Phil Cavarretta last played in 1955.

What are Phil Cavarretta's nicknames?

Philliabuck is a nickname for Phil Cavarretta.
